summary: CICS online Sign-on (authentication) screen -- the application's entry point. Prompts for a user id and password, validates both are entered, reads the user security file, checks the password, and routes the user to the Admin menu or the regular Main menu based on their user type. The security gate for the whole CardDemo online application.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the sign-on screen. On re-entry evaluate the key: PF3 exit the application; Enter run the sign-on validation. Return to CICS with the COMMAREA.

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the sign-on map. Require a user id ('Please enter User ID') and a password ('Please enter Password'); if either is missing, re-display with the error. Upper-case the entered user id and password, then read the user security file to authenticate.
branches: IF not error -> read security file

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: both user id and password are mandatory; credentials are upper-cased before lookup.

paragraphs.name: READ-USER-SEC-FILE
paragraphs.pseudocode: Read the user security record by user id. If the user is not found, report 'user not found'. If found, compare the entered password to the stored password: on mismatch report 'wrong password'; on match, route the user by user type -- Admin users to the Admin menu program, regular users to the Main menu program (via CICS XCTL), passing the user context in the COMMAREA.
branches: IF user type = Admin -> XCTL admin menu ELSE XCTL main menu

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: authentication requires an existing user id whose stored password matches the entry; admins and regular users are routed to different menus by user type.

paragraphs.notes: BUSINESS-CRITICAL: the authentication and role-based routing rule.

paragraphs.name: SEND-SIGNON-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the header and any message, then send the sign-on map to the terminal.

paragraphs.name: RECEIVE-SIGNON-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Receive the sign-on map from the terminal.

paragraphs.name: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the screen header (title, date, time, program/transaction ids).
